title: [Latest dev] No profile change if only the target area was changed
symptom: If I change the target area in a Local Profile and save it, then trigger a profile change, the profile change is not performed and the previous targets remain active.
cause: The thread does not explicitly identify a root cause; it is implied that the profile change is not triggered when only the target area is changed, but no specific cause is stated.
fix: The issue was fixed by a commit: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/7243f8fb6645b8de9271f1a0b55352231b2c9015
